name: Double Density or Average Degree of Majority
proof: There is one concept for each base subset, so the graph has $2^n$ vertices.  Starting from the $n2^{n-1}$ edges of the $n$-cube, exactly $(n-t)\binom nt$ edges between layers $t=\lfloor n/2\rfloor$ and $t+1$ are deleted because their endpoints have different majority bits.  Dividing twice the remaining edge count by $2^n$ gives the displayed average degree.
